{{Stun|Partial Stun Slowdown}}Partial Stun Slowdown }} ==Description== '''Partial Electric Immunity''' was an immunity that prevented the enemy from being pushed back by the [[Electroshocker]] and made the slowdown effect weaker. It was replaced by [[Energy Immunity]], which was later replaced by the [[Stun Immunity]]. ==Mechanics== '''Partial Electric Immunity''' made it so that enemies are not pushed back by the [[Electroshocker]]. It also made them less affected by its slowdown, only being slowed down by 15% instead of the usual 30%. ==Enemy List== The following enemies had '''Partial Electric Immunity''': {{Scroll|text= *[[Slow Boss]] *[[Chained Boss]] *[[Giant Boss]] *[[Shock]] *[[Charge]] *[[Glitch]] *[[Speedy Boss]] *[[Splitter (Polluted Wasteland)|Splitter]] *[[Split (Polluted Wasteland)|Split]] *[[Mystery Summoner]] *[[Summoner Boss]] *[[Error]] *[[Circuit (Hardcore)|Circuit]] *[[Molten Titan]] *[[24 Karat]] *[[Fallen Hero (Legacy)|Fallen Hero]] (Legacy version) *[[Gold Guard]] *[[Glitched Giant]] *[[Grave Digger (Legacy)|Grave Digger]] (Legacy version) *[[Molten Boss]] *[[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] (Legacy version) *[[Nuclear Fallen King]] }} ==Update History== *'''11 February 2020''' - [[Release v1.7|Release v1.7.0]] **'''Partial Electric Immunity''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Partial Electric Immunity''' removed, replaced by [[Energy Immunity]]. {{AttributeNavBox}}
